In-house job search with type/state filters, bilingual APPLY/APLICAR entry and 'SA Internal jobs' section

agent_readiness.notes: robots.txt is open but sets Crawl-delay: 30 for every crawler. Office addresses, direct phone numbers and hours-adjacent info are crawlable text; job search, apply and safety pages are indexable. Schema is only Organization + WebSite (no branch LocalBusiness, no service list). The candidate path is semi-bookable (job search + apply), but an employer's agent cannot request staff, get a quote or schedule a call - there is not even a contact form.

Dedicated safety program page and internal jobs listing suggest separate compliance and internal recruiting workloads

scores.reasons: A 20-office, 30-year firm with real content but no employer intake form, no H1s and thin schema - clear, valuable gaps; scale implies budget; the employer-intake build is medium and the candidate automation is larger; evidence from live pages and robots, though branch-level Google data was not verified.

caveats: Phone-width checks were done by loading each site in a 390px iframe inside the browser because the browser's device-metrics override did not persist; treat 'phone_layout' as an approximation except where a missing viewport meta tag gave a hard answer (V2 Technologies: no viewport meta, 991px fixed layout).
Listing ratings are reported only where a review or directory page was actually seen in search results; blank means no Google Business Profile rating could be verified.
No contact forms were submitted, no CAPTCHAs attempted and no logins used anywhere in this batch.
